#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试脚本
# 用途：测试各核心组在不同频率下的性能/功耗/能效比
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/energy_bench.sh'
# 输出：结果同时打印到终端和保存到脚本同目录
# 需求：Root 权限
# 注意：测试期间保持屏幕常亮，测试完自动恢复
# ============================================

# 获取脚本所在目录
SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

mkdir -p "$SCRIPT_DIR"

# ============================================
# 配置区 - 根据 platform_probe.sh 的结果修改
# ============================================

# 骁龙8至尊版 Policy 配置
# 中核组 (cpu0-5)
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
# 大核组 (cpu6-7)
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

# 测试参数
BENCH_DURATION=5          # 每次测试持续秒数
COOL_DOWN=3               # 每次测试后冷却秒数

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

# 同时输出到终端和日志文件
log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# 读取当前功耗 (uA)，负值表示放电
read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    # 负值取反
    if [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo $((0 - raw))
    else
        echo "$raw"
    fi
}

# 读取电压 (uV)
read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

# 读取温度 (返回摄氏度整数)
# 骁龙8至尊版温度传感器：cpuss-0-0 (中核), cpuss-1-0 (大核)
read_temp() {
    # 优先读取 cpuss 传感器
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    # 兜底：任意 CPU 温度
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if echo "$type" | grep -q "cpu-0-0-0"; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

# CPU 负载测试 - 纯整数运算
cpu_workload() {
    local duration=$1
    local end_time=$(($(date +%s) + duration))
    local count=0
    while [ $(date +%s) -lt $end_time ]; do
        count=$((count + 1))
        count=$((count * 7 + 13))
        count=$((count % 1000000))
        echo "$count" > /dev/null
    done
    echo "$count"
}

# 锁定频率
lock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 0.3
    local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$actual" = "$freq" ] && return 0 || return 1
}

# 恢复频率范围
unlock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
    local min_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_min_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$min_avail" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$max_avail" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
}

# 获取可用频率列表
get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

# 绑定 CPU
bind_cpus() {
    taskset -p "$1" $$ 2>/dev/null
}

# 采样多次取平均电流
sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    for i in $(seq 1 $samples); do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.2
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# 单次测试
run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    # 锁频
    lock_freq "$policy" "$freq"
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "  警告: 无法锁定到 ${freq_mhz}MHz，跳过"
        return 1
    fi

    # 绑核
    bind_cpus "$cpus"
    sleep 0.5

    # 采样基线功耗
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 运行负载
    log "  运行负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s..."
    local start_ns=$(date +%s%N)
    cpu_workload $BENCH_DURATION > /dev/null
    local end_ns=$(date +%s%N)

    # 计算耗时 (ns -> ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$(( (end_ns - start_ns) / 1000000 ))

    # 采样负载功耗
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算功耗差值
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0

    # 功耗 (mW) = 电流(uA) * 电压(uV) / 1000000000
    local power_mw=$((delta_current * voltage / 1000000000))

    # 性能分数 (耗时越短越高)
    local perf_score=$((1000000 / (elapsed_ms + 1)))

    # 能效比 = 性能 / 功耗
    if [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ]; then
        local efficiency=$((perf_score * 100 / power_mw))
    else
        local efficiency=999999
    fi

    # 写入 CSV
    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_score,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  耗时: ${elapsed_ms}ms | 电流差: ${delta_current}uA | 功耗: ${power_mw}mW | 能效比: $efficiency"
    log "  温度: ${base_temp}°C → ${load_temp}°C | 冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN

    return 0
}

# ============================================
# 主测试流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试"
    log "=========================================="

    # 检查 Root
    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        log "请使用: su -c 'sh $0'"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 检查功耗接口
    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
        log "错误: 无法读取电流数据，请确认设备支持"
        exit 1
    fi

    local init_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "初始温度: ${init_temp}°C"
    log "结果CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "日志文件: $LOG_FILE"
    log ""

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,频率MHz,耗时ms,基线电流uA,负载电流uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线温度C,负载温度C,性能分,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"

    # 保存并切换 governor (测试用 performance，结束后恢复)
    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    log "原始 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已切换到 performance governor 进行测试"
    log ""

    # ---- 中核组 ----
    log "====== 测试中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核"
    done
    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
    log ""

    # ---- 大核组 ----
    log "====== 测试大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核"
    done
    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
    log ""

    # 恢复 governor (高通平台用 walt)
    echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已恢复 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"

    local final_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "=========================================="
    log "  测试完成!"
    log "  最终温度: ${final_temp}°C"
    log "  CSV 结果: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  运行日志: $LOG_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
    log ""
    log "导出到电脑:"
    log "  adb pull $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  adb pull $LOG_FILE"
}

main "$@"

        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核"

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试脚本
# 用途：测试各核心组在不同频率下的性能/功耗/能效比
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/energy_bench.sh'
# 输出：结果同时打印到终端和保存到脚本同目录
# 需求：Root 权限
# 注意：测试期间保持屏幕常亮，测试完自动恢复
# ============================================

# 获取脚本所在目录
SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

mkdir -p "$SCRIPT_DIR"

# ============================================
# 屏幕常亮控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# 设置屏幕常亮（永不息屏 + 最低亮度省电）
enable_screen_on() {
    # 设置永不息屏 (2147483647 = INT_MAX)
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    # 设置最低亮度 (1) 减少功耗干扰
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null
    log "屏幕常亮已开启 (最低亮度)"
}

# 恢复原始屏幕设置
restore_screen() {
    if [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ]; then
        settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    if [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ]; then
        settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    log "屏幕设置已恢复"
}

# ============================================
# 配置区 - 根据 platform_probe.sh 的结果修改
# ============================================

# 骁龙8至尊版 Policy 配置
# 中核组 (cpu0-5)
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
# 大核组 (cpu6-7)
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

# 测试参数
BENCH_DURATION=5          # 每次测试持续秒数
COOL_DOWN=3               # 每次测试后冷却秒数

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

# 同时输出到终端和日志文件
log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# 读取当前功耗 (uA)，负值表示放电
read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    # 负值取反
    if [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo $((0 - raw))
    else
        echo "$raw"
    fi
}

# 读取电压 (uV)
read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

# 读取温度 (返回摄氏度整数)
# 骁龙8至尊版温度传感器：cpuss-0-0 (中核), cpuss-1-0 (大核)
read_temp() {
    # 优先读取 cpuss 传感器
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    # 兜底：任意 CPU 温度
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if echo "$type" | grep -q "cpu-0-0-0"; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

# CPU 负载测试 - 纯整数运算
cpu_workload() {
    local duration=$1
    local end_time=$(($(date +%s) + duration))
    local count=0
    while [ $(date +%s) -lt $end_time ]; do
        count=$((count + 1))
        count=$((count * 7 + 13))
        count=$((count % 1000000))
        echo "$count" > /dev/null
    done
    echo "$count"
}

# 锁定频率
lock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 0.3
    local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$actual" = "$freq" ] && return 0 || return 1
}

# 恢复频率范围
unlock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
    local min_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_min_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$min_avail" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$max_avail" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
}

# 获取可用频率列表
get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

# 绑定 CPU
bind_cpus() {
    taskset -p "$1" $$ 2>/dev/null
}

# 采样多次取平均电流
sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    for i in $(seq 1 $samples); do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.2
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# 单次测试
run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    # 锁频
    lock_freq "$policy" "$freq"
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "  警告: 无法锁定到 ${freq_mhz}MHz，跳过"
        return 1
    fi

    # 绑核
    bind_cpus "$cpus"
    sleep 0.5

    # 采样基线功耗
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 运行负载
    log "  运行负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s..."
    local start_ns=$(date +%s%N)
    cpu_workload $BENCH_DURATION > /dev/null
    local end_ns=$(date +%s%N)

    # 计算耗时 (ns -> ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$(( (end_ns - start_ns) / 1000000 ))

    # 采样负载功耗
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算功耗差值
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0

    # 功耗 (mW) = 电流(uA) * 电压(uV) / 1000000000
    local power_mw=$((delta_current * voltage / 1000000000))

    # 性能分数 (耗时越短越高)
    local perf_score=$((1000000 / (elapsed_ms + 1)))

    # 能效比 = 性能 / 功耗
    if [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ]; then
        local efficiency=$((perf_score * 100 / power_mw))
    else
        local efficiency=999999
    fi

    # 写入 CSV
    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_score,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  耗时: ${elapsed_ms}ms | 电流差: ${delta_current}uA | 功耗: ${power_mw}mW | 能效比: $efficiency"
    log "  温度: ${base_temp}°C → ${load_temp}°C | 冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN

    return 0
}

# ============================================
# 主测试流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试"
    log "=========================================="

    # 检查 Root
    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        log "请使用: su -c 'sh $0'"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 检查功耗接口
    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
        log "错误: 无法读取电流数据，请确认设备支持"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 开启屏幕常亮
    enable_screen_on

    local init_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "初始温度: ${init_temp}°C"
    log "结果CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "日志文件: $LOG_FILE"
    log ""

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,频率MHz,耗时ms,基线电流uA,负载电流uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线温度C,负载温度C,性能分,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"

    # 保存并切换 governor (测试用 performance，结束后恢复)
    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    log "原始 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已切换到 performance governor 进行测试"
    log ""

    # ---- 中核组 ----
    log "====== 测试中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核"
    done
    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
    log ""

    # ---- 大核组 ----
    log "====== 测试大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核"
    done
    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
    log ""

    # 恢复 governor (高通平台用 walt)
    echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已恢复 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"

    local final_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "=========================================="
    log "  测试完成!"
    log "  最终温度: ${final_temp}°C"
    log "  CSV 结果: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  运行日志: $LOG_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
    log ""
    log "导出到电脑:"
    log "  adb pull $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  adb pull $LOG_FILE"
}

main "$@"

LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

mkdir -p "$SCRIPT_DIR"

# ============================================
# 屏幕常亮控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# 设置屏幕常亮（永不息屏 + 最低亮度省电）
enable_screen_on() {
    # 设置永不息屏 (2147483647 = INT_MAX)
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    # 设置最低亮度 (1) 减少功耗干扰
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null
    log "屏幕常亮已开启 (最低亮度)"
}

# 恢复原始屏幕设置
restore_screen() {
    if [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ]; then
        settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    if [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ]; then
        settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    log "屏幕设置已恢复"
}

# ============================================
# 配置区 - 根据 platform_probe.sh 的结果修改
# ============================================

# 骁龙8至尊版 Policy 配置
# 中核组 (cpu0-5)
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
# 大核组 (cpu6-7)
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

# 测试参数
BENCH_DURATION=5          # 每次测试持续秒数
COOL_DOWN=3               # 每次测试后冷却秒数

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

# 同时输出到终端和日志文件
log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# 读取当前功耗 (uA)，负值表示放电
read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    # 负值取反
    if [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo $((0 - raw))
    else
        echo "$raw"
    fi
}

# 读取电压 (uV)
read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

# 读取温度 (返回摄氏度整数)
# 骁龙8至尊版温度传感器：cpuss-0-0 (中核), cpuss-1-0 (大核)
read_temp() {
    # 优先读取 cpuss 传感器
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    # 兜底：任意 CPU 温度
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if echo "$type" | grep -q "cpu-0-0-0"; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

# CPU 负载测试 - 纯整数运算
cpu_workload() {
    local duration=$1
    local end_time=$(($(date +%s) + duration))
    local count=0
    while [ $(date +%s) -lt $end_time ]; do
        count=$((count + 1))
        count=$((count * 7 + 13))
        count=$((count % 1000000))
        echo "$count" > /dev/null
    done
    echo "$count"
}

# 锁定频率
lock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 0.3
    local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$actual" = "$freq" ] && return 0 || return 1
}

# 恢复频率范围
unlock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
    local min_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_min_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$min_avail" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$max_avail" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
}

# 获取可用频率列表
get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

# 绑定 CPU
bind_cpus() {
    taskset -p "$1" $$ 2>/dev/null
}

# 采样多次取平均电流
sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    for i in $(seq 1 $samples); do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.2
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# 单次测试
run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    # 锁频
    lock_freq "$policy" "$freq"
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "  警告: 无法锁定到 ${freq_mhz}MHz，跳过"
        return 1
    fi

    # 绑核
    bind_cpus "$cpus"
    sleep 0.5

    # 采样基线功耗
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 运行负载
    log "  运行负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s..."
    local start_ns=$(date +%s%N)
    cpu_workload $BENCH_DURATION > /dev/null
    local end_ns=$(date +%s%N)

    # 计算耗时 (ns -> ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$(( (end_ns - start_ns) / 1000000 ))

    # 采样负载功耗
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算功耗差值
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0

    # 功耗 (mW) = 电流(uA) * 电压(uV) / 1000000000
    local power_mw=$((delta_current * voltage / 1000000000))

    # 性能分数 (耗时越短越高)
    local perf_score=$((1000000 / (elapsed_ms + 1)))

    # 能效比 = 性能 / 功耗
    if [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ]; then
        local efficiency=$((perf_score * 100 / power_mw))
    else
        local efficiency=999999
    fi

    # 写入 CSV
    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_score,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  耗时: ${elapsed_ms}ms | 电流差: ${delta_current}uA | 功耗: ${power_mw}mW | 能效比: $efficiency"
    log "  温度: ${base_temp}°C → ${load_temp}°C | 冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN

    return 0
}

# ============================================
# 主测试流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试"
    log "=========================================="

    # 检查 Root
    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        log "请使用: su -c 'sh $0'"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 检查功耗接口
    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
        log "错误: 无法读取电流数据，请确认设备支持"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 开启屏幕常亮
    enable_screen_on

    local init_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "初始温度: ${init_temp}°C"
    log "结果CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "日志文件: $LOG_FILE"
    log ""

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,频率MHz,耗时ms,基线电流uA,负载电流uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线温度C,负载温度C,性能分,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"

    # 保存并切换 governor (测试用 performance，结束后恢复)
    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    log "原始 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已切换到 performance governor 进行测试"
    log ""

    # ---- 中核组 ----
    log "====== 测试中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核"
    done
    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
    log ""

    # ---- 大核组 ----
    log "====== 测试大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核"
    done
    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
    log ""

    # 恢复 governor (高通平台用 walt)
    echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已恢复 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"

    # 恢复屏幕设置
    restore_screen

    local final_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "=========================================="
    log "  测试完成!"
    log "  最终温度: ${final_temp}°C"
    log "  CSV 结果: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  运行日志: $LOG_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
    log ""
    log "导出到电脑:"
    log "  adb pull $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  adb pull $LOG_FILE"
}

main "$@"

LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

# ============================================

# 配置区

MID_CPUS="0-5"
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

# ============================================
# 时间测量（修复 Android 兼容性）

    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null

    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null

bind_cpus() {
    taskset -p "$1" $$ 2>/dev/null

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))

# ============================================
# 单次测试
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz (锁定中...)"

    # 锁频
    lock_freq "$policy" "$freq"

    bind_cpus "$cpus"
    sleep 0.5

    log "  采样基线功耗..."
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 运行负载

        total_iters=$((total_iters + WORKLOAD_ITERATIONS))
    done

    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))

    log "  采样负载功耗..."

    local load_temp=$(read_temp)

    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))

    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    local iters_per_sec=0
    if [ "$elapsed_ms" -gt 0 ]; then
        iters_per_sec=$((total_iters * 1000 / elapsed_ms))
    fi
    local perf_score=$((iters_per_sec / 1000))

    # 能效比 = 每毫瓦完成的千次迭代
    local efficiency=0
    if [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ]; then
        efficiency=$((perf_score * 100 / power_mw))
    else
        efficiency=999999
    fi

    # 输出
    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_score,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  结果: 耗时=${elapsed_ms}ms 迭代=$total_iters 性能=${perf_score}k/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=$efficiency"
    log "  温度: ${base_temp}°C → ${load_temp}°C | 冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN

    return 0
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v2"
    log "=========================================="

    # 检查 Root
    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        log "请使用: su -c 'sh $0'"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 检查功耗接口
    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
        log "错误: 无法读取电流数据"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 屏幕常亮
    enable_screen_on

    local init_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "初始温度: ${init_temp}°C"
    log "结果CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "日志文件: $LOG_FILE"
    log ""

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,频率MHz,耗时ms,基线电流uA,负载电流uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线温度C,负载温度C,性能分k/s,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"

    # 保存 governor
    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    log "原始 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"

    # 切换到 performance governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已切换到 performance governor"
    log ""

    # ---- 中核组 ----
    log "====== 测试中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    local mid_passed=0
    local mid_total=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        mid_total=$((mid_total + 1))
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核"
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            mid_passed=$((mid_passed + 1))
        fi
    done
    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
    log "中核组完成: $mid_passed/$mid_total 个频率点"
    log ""

    # ---- 大核组 ----
    log "====== 测试大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    local big_passed=0
    local big_total=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        big_total=$((big_total + 1))
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核"
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            big_passed=$((big_passed + 1))
        fi
    done
    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
    log "大核组完成: $big_passed/$big_total 个频率点"
    log ""

    # 恢复
    echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已恢复 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"

    restore_screen

    local final_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "=========================================="
    log "  测试完成!"
    log "  最终温度: ${final_temp}°C"
    log "  CSV 结果: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  运行日志: $LOG_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
    log ""
    log "导出到电脑:"
    log "  adb pull $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  adb pull $LOG_FILE"
}

main "$@"

    # 输出
    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_score,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  结果: 耗时=${elapsed_ms}ms 迭代=$total_iters 性能=${perf_score}k/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=$efficiency"
    log "  温度: ${base_temp}°C → ${load_temp}°C | 冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN

    return 0
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v2"
    log "=========================================="

    # 检查 Root
    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        log "请使用: su -c 'sh $0'"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 检查功耗接口
    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
        log "错误: 无法读取电流数据"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 屏幕常亮
    enable_screen_on

    local init_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "初始温度: ${init_temp}°C"
    log "结果CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "日志文件: $LOG_FILE"
    log ""

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,频率MHz,耗时ms,基线电流uA,负载电流uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线温度C,负载温度C,性能分k/s,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"

    # 保存 governor
    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    log "原始 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"

    # 切换到 performance governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已切换到 performance governor"
    log ""

    # ---- 中核组 ----
    log "====== 测试中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    local mid_passed=0
    local mid_total=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        mid_total=$((mid_total + 1))
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核"
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            mid_passed=$((mid_passed + 1))
        fi
    done
    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
    log "中核组完成: $mid_passed/$mid_total 个频率点"
    log ""

    # ---- 大核组 ----
    log "====== 测试大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    local big_passed=0
    local big_total=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        big_total=$((big_total + 1))
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核"
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            big_passed=$((big_passed + 1))
        fi
    done
    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
    log "大核组完成: $big_passed/$big_total 个频率点"
    log ""

    # 恢复
    echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已恢复 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"

    restore_screen

    local final_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "=========================================="
    log "  测试完成!"
    log "  最终温度: ${final_temp}°C"
    log "  CSV 结果: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  运行日志: $LOG_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
    log ""
    log "导出到电脑:"
    log "  adb pull $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  adb pull $LOG_FILE"
}

main "$@"

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试脚本
# 用途：测试各核心组在不同频率下的性能/功耗/能效比
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/energy_bench.sh'
# 输出：结果同时打印到终端和保存到脚本同目录
# 需求：Root 权限
# 注意：测试期间保持屏幕常亮，测试完自动恢复
# ============================================

# 获取脚本所在目录
SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

mkdir -p "$SCRIPT_DIR"

# ============================================
# 屏幕常亮控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# 设置屏幕常亮（永不息屏 + 最低亮度省电）
enable_screen_on() {
    # 设置永不息屏 (2147483647 = INT_MAX)
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    # 设置最低亮度 (1) 减少功耗干扰
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null
    log "屏幕常亮已开启 (最低亮度)"
}

# 恢复原始屏幕设置
restore_screen() {
    if [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ]; then
        settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    if [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ]; then
        settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    log "屏幕设置已恢复"
}

# ============================================
# 配置区 - 根据 platform_probe.sh 的结果修改
# ============================================

# 骁龙8至尊版 Policy 配置
# 中核组 (cpu0-5)
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
# 大核组 (cpu6-7)
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

# 测试参数
BENCH_DURATION=5          # 每次测试持续秒数
COOL_DOWN=3               # 每次测试后冷却秒数

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

# 同时输出到终端和日志文件
log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# 读取当前功耗 (uA)，负值表示放电
read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    # 负值取反
    if [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo $((0 - raw))
    else
        echo "$raw"
    fi
}

# 读取电压 (uV)
read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

# 读取温度 (返回摄氏度整数)
# 骁龙8至尊版温度传感器：cpuss-0-0 (中核), cpuss-1-0 (大核)
read_temp() {
    # 优先读取 cpuss 传感器
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    # 兜底：任意 CPU 温度
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if echo "$type" | grep -q "cpu-0-0-0"; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

# CPU 负载测试 - 纯整数运算
cpu_workload() {
    local duration=$1
    local end_time=$(($(date +%s) + duration))
    local count=0
    while [ $(date +%s) -lt $end_time ]; do
        count=$((count + 1))
        count=$((count * 7 + 13))
        count=$((count % 1000000))
        echo "$count" > /dev/null
    done
    echo "$count"
}

# 锁定频率
lock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 0.3
    local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$actual" = "$freq" ] && return 0 || return 1
}

# 恢复频率范围
unlock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
    local min_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_min_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$min_avail" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$max_avail" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
}

# 获取可用频率列表
get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

# 绑定 CPU
bind_cpus() {
    taskset -p "$1" $$ 2>/dev/null
}

# 采样多次取平均电流
sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    for i in $(seq 1 $samples); do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.2
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# 单次测试
run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    # 锁频
    lock_freq "$policy" "$freq"
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "  警告: 无法锁定到 ${freq_mhz}MHz，跳过"
        return 1
    fi

    # 绑核
    bind_cpus "$cpus"
    sleep 0.5

    # 采样基线功耗
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 运行负载
    log "  运行负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s..."
    local start_ns=$(date +%s%N)
    cpu_workload $BENCH_DURATION > /dev/null
    local end_ns=$(date +%s%N)

    # 计算耗时 (ns -> ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$(( (end_ns - start_ns) / 1000000 ))

    # 采样负载功耗
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算功耗差值
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0

    # 功耗 (mW) = 电流(uA) * 电压(uV) / 1000000000
    local power_mw=$((delta_current * voltage / 1000000000))

    # 性能分数 (耗时越短越高)
    local perf_score=$((1000000 / (elapsed_ms + 1)))

    # 能效比 = 性能 / 功耗
    if [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ]; then
        local efficiency=$((perf_score * 100 / power_mw))
    else
        local efficiency=999999
    fi

    # 写入 CSV
    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_score,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  耗时: ${elapsed_ms}ms | 电流差: ${delta_current}uA | 功耗: ${power_mw}mW | 能效比: $efficiency"
    log "  温度: ${base_temp}°C → ${load_temp}°C | 冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN

    return 0
}

# ============================================
# 主测试流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试"
    log "=========================================="

    # 检查 Root
    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        log "请使用: su -c 'sh $0'"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 检查功耗接口
    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
        log "错误: 无法读取电流数据，请确认设备支持"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 开启屏幕常亮（最低亮度，减少功耗干扰）
    enable_screen_on

    local init_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "初始温度: ${init_temp}°C"
    log "结果CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "日志文件: $LOG_FILE"
    log ""

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,频率MHz,耗时ms,基线电流uA,负载电流uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线温度C,负载温度C,性能分,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"

    # 保存并切换 governor (测试用 performance，结束后恢复)
    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    log "原始 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已切换到 performance governor 进行测试"
    log ""

    # ---- 中核组 ----
    log "====== 测试中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核"
    done
    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
    log ""

    # ---- 大核组 ----
    log "====== 测试大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核"
    done
    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
    log ""

    # 恢复 governor (高通平台用 walt)
    echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log "已恢复 Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"

    # 恢复屏幕设置
    restore_screen

    local final_temp=$(read_temp)
    log "=========================================="
    log "  测试完成!"
    log "  最终温度: ${final_temp}°C"
    log "  CSV 结果: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  运行日志: $LOG_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
    log ""
    log "导出到电脑:"
    log "  adb pull $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  adb pull $LOG_FILE"
}

main "$@"

# ============================================
# 能耗比测试结果分析脚本 v2
# 自动检测脚本同目录下的最新 CSV
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
OUTPUT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/analysis_${TIMESTAMP}.txt"

log() {
    echo "$1"
    echo "$1" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
}

LATEST=$(ls -t "$SCRIPT_DIR"/energy_bench_*.csv 2>/dev/null | head -1)

if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
    log "错误: 在 $SCRIPT_DIR 下找不到测试结果文件"
    exit 1
fi

log "=========================================="
log "  能耗比测试结果分析"
log "  数据源: $LATEST"
log "  分析时间: $(date)"
log "  输出: $OUTPUT_FILE"
log "=========================================="
log ""

# 统计有效数据
total=$(tail -n +2 "$LATEST" | wc -l)
mid_count=$(grep "^中核," "$LATEST" | wc -l)
big_count=$(grep "^大核," "$LATEST" | wc -l)
mid_skip=$(grep "^中核," "$LATEST" | awk -F',' '$3<100 || $7<=0' | wc -l)
big_skip=$(grep "^大核," "$LATEST" | awk -F',' '$3<100 || $7<=0' | wc -l)

log "数据概览: 总计 $total 条 (中核 $mid_count 条, 大核 $big_count 条)"
log "疑似异常: 中核 $mid_skip 条, 大核 $big_skip 条 (耗时<100ms 或 功耗<=0)"
log ""

# ---- 中核组 ----
log "====== 中核组 (policy0: cpu0-5) ======"
log ""
log "频率(MHz) | 耗时(ms) | 基线uA | 负载uA | 功耗(mW) | 性能k/s | 能效比"
log "----------|----------|--------|--------|----------|---------|--------"
grep "^中核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k2 -n | while IFS=',' read label freq elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do
    # 标记可疑数据
    flag=""

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 能耗比测试结果分析脚本
# 运行：adb shell sh /sdcard/analyze_results.sh
# 输出：结果同时打印到终端和保存到脚本同目录
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
OUTPUT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/analysis_${TIMESTAMP}.txt"

# 同时输出到终端和文件
log() {
    echo "$1"
    echo "$1" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
}

# 查找最新的 CSV 结果文件
LATEST=$(ls -t "$SCRIPT_DIR"/energy_bench_*.csv 2>/dev/null | head -1)

if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
    log "错误: 在 $SCRIPT_DIR 下找不到测试结果文件"
    log "请先运行 energy_bench.sh"
    exit 1
fi

log "=========================================="
log "  能耗比测试结果分析"
log "  数据源: $LATEST"
log "  分析时间: $(date)"
log "  输出文件: $OUTPUT_FILE"
log "=========================================="
log ""

# 原始数据
log "------ 原始数据 ------"
while IFS= read -r line; do
    log "$line"
done < "$LATEST"
log ""

# 中核组分析
log "------ 中核组 (policy0) 分析 ------"
log "频率(MHz) | 耗时(ms) | 功耗(mW) | 能效比"
log "----------|----------|----------|--------"
grep "^中核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k2 -n | while IFS=',' read label freq elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do
    log "$(printf '%-10s| %-9s| %-9s| %s' "$freq" "$elapsed" "$power" "$eff")"
done
log ""

# 大核组分析
log "------ 大核组 (policy6) 分析 ------"
log "频率(MHz) | 耗时(ms) | 功耗(mW) | 能效比"
log "----------|----------|----------|--------"
grep "^大核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k2 -n | while IFS=',' read label freq elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do
    log "$(printf '%-10s| %-9s| %-9s| %s' "$freq" "$elapsed" "$power" "$eff")"
done
log ""

# 最佳能效比
log "------ 最佳能效比频率 ------"
log ""
mid_best_eff=$(grep "^中核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k11 -nr | head -1)
big_best_eff=$(grep "^大核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k11 -nr | head -1)

if [ -n "$mid_best_eff" ]; then
    echo "$mid_best_eff" | while IFS=',' read label freq elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do
        log "中核组最佳能效: ${freq}MHz | 功耗: ${power}mW | 能效比: $eff"
    done
fi

if [ -n "$big_best_eff" ]; then
    echo "$big_best_eff" | while IFS=',' read label freq elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do
        log "大核组最佳能效: ${freq}MHz | 功耗: ${power}mW | 能效比: $eff"
    done
fi
log ""

# 最高性能
log "------ 最高性能频率 ------"
log ""
mid_best_perf=$(grep "^中核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k10 -nr | head -1)
big_best_perf=$(grep "^大核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k10 -nr | head -1)

if [ -n "$mid_best_perf" ]; then
    echo "$mid_best_perf" | while IFS=',' read label freq elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do
        log "中核组最高性能: ${freq}MHz | 耗时: ${elapsed}ms | 性能分: $perf"
    done
fi

if [ -n "$big_best_perf" ]; then
    echo "$big_best_perf" | while IFS=',' read label freq elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do
        log "大核组最高性能: ${freq}MHz | 耗时: ${elapsed}ms | 性能分: $perf"
    done
fi
log ""

# 频率-功耗曲线数据
log "------ 频率-功耗趋势 ------"
log ""
log "中核组:"
grep "^中核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k2 -n | while IFS=',' read label freq elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do
    bar_len=$((power / 5))
    bar=""
    for i in $(seq 1 $bar_len 2>/dev/null); do bar="${bar}#"; done
    log "  ${freq}MHz: $(printf '%-5s' ${power}mW) $bar"
done
log ""

grep "^大核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k2 -n | while IFS=',' read label freq elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do
    bar_len=$((power / 5))

    for i in $(seq 1 $bar_len 2>/dev/null); do bar="${bar}#"; done
    log "  ${freq}MHz: $(printf '%-5s' ${power}mW) $bar"
done
log ""

# 调度建议
log "------ 调度策略建议 ------"
log ""
log "1. App 启动场景:"
log "   - 启动瞬间: 大核最高频率 (性能优先)"
log "   - 首帧渲染后: 切到中核最佳能效频率"

log "2. 日常使用:"
log "   - 默认: 中核最佳能效频率"
log "   - 按需 boost: 短暂提升到大核"

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试脚本 v3
# 改进：使用 CPU-bound 工作负载，避开内存瓶颈
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/energy_bench_v3.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

mkdir -p "$SCRIPT_DIR"

# ============================================
# 屏幕常亮控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

enable_screen_on() {
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null
    log "屏幕常亮已开启 (最低亮度)"
}

restore_screen() {
    [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ] && settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ] && settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null
    log "屏幕设置已恢复"
}

# ============================================
# 配置区
# ============================================

MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

BENCH_DURATION=10
COOL_DOWN=5

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    if [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo $((0 - raw))
    else
        echo "$raw"
    fi
}

read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

read_temp() {
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

get_time_ms() {
    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    local sec=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f1)
    local frac=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f2)
    frac=$(echo "$frac" | cut -c1-2)
    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
}

# ============================================
# CPU-bound 工作负载
# 核心思想：使用大量寄存器操作，减少内存访问
# 纯 ALU 运算，让性能真正跟随频率变化
# ============================================

cpu_workload() {
    local n=$1
    # 多变量交替运算，全部在寄存器中完成
    local a=1 b=2 c=3 d=4 e=5 f=6 g=7 h=8
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $n ]; do
        a=$(( (a * 3 + b) & 0xFFFF ))
        b=$(( (b * 5 + c) & 0xFFFF ))
        c=$(( (c * 7 + d) & 0xFFFF ))
        d=$(( (d * 11 + e) & 0xFFFF ))
        e=$(( (e * 13 + f) & 0xFFFF ))
        f=$(( (f * 17 + g) & 0xFFFF ))
        g=$(( (g * 19 + h) & 0xFFFF ))
        h=$(( (h * 23 + a) & 0xFFFF ))
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo "$a"
}

lock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    echo 0 > "$base/boost" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 0.5

    local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    local lower=$((freq * 95 / 100))
    local upper=$((freq * 105 / 100))

    if [ "$actual" -ge "$lower" ] && [ "$actual" -le "$upper" ] 2>/dev/null; then
        return 0
    fi

    # 重试
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 0.2
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 0.5

    actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$actual" -ge "$lower" ] && [ "$actual" -le "$upper" ] 2>/dev/null; then
        return 0
    fi

    return 1
}

unlock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
    local min_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_min_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$min_avail" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$max_avail" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
}

get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

bind_cpus() {
    taskset -p "$1" $$ 2>/dev/null
}

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# 校准测试：确认工作负载是 CPU-bound
# 策略：跑两次不同迭代数，检查时间比例
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准工作负载..."

    # 锁定到中等频率
    lock_freq "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    bind_cpus "$MID_CPUS"
    sleep 1

    # 小批量
    local t1=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 100000 > /dev/null
    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_small=$((t2 - t1))

    # 大批量
    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 500000 > /dev/null
    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_large=$((t4 - t3))

    unlock_freq "$MID_POLICY"

    local ratio=$((ms_large * 100 / ms_small))
    log "  100k迭代: ${ms_small}ms | 500k迭代: ${ms_large}ms | 比例: ${ratio}%"

    # 理想比例应该是 ~500%
    if [ "$ratio" -gt 300 ] && [ "$ratio" -lt 700 ]; then
        log "  ✓ 工作负载可扩展性良好 (${ratio}%)"
    elif [ "$ratio" -gt 200 ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 工作负载可扩展性一般 (${ratio}%)"
    else
        log "  ✗ 工作负载可扩展性差 (${ratio}%)，结果可能不准确"
    fi
    log ""

    # 选择合适的迭代数：目标每轮 ~50ms
    local iter_per_ms=$((500000 / (ms_large + 1)))
    local target_iters=$((iter_per_ms * 50))
    # 下取整到万
    target_iters=$((target_iters / 10000 * 10000))
    [ "$target_iters" -lt 10000 ] && target_iters=10000
    [ "$target_iters" -gt 1000000 ] && target_iters=1000000

    log "  推荐每轮迭代数: $target_iters (目标 ~50ms/轮)"
    WORKLOAD_ITERS=$target_iters
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    lock_freq "$policy" "$freq"
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "  跳过: 无法锁定"
        return 1
    fi

    local actual_freq=$(cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  锁定: $((actual_freq/1000))MHz"

    bind_cpus "$cpus"
    sleep 0.5

    # 基线功耗
    log "  采样基线..."
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 运行负载
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s (每轮${WORKLOAD_ITERS}次)..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local end_ms=$((start_ms + BENCH_DURATION * 1000))
    local total_iters=0
    while [ $(get_time_ms) -lt $end_ms ]; do
        cpu_workload $WORKLOAD_ITERS > /dev/null
        total_iters=$((total_iters + WORKLOAD_ITERS))
    done
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))

    # 负载功耗
    log "  采样负载..."
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 功耗计算 (避免溢出)
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    # 性能 = 每秒千次迭代
    local iters_per_sec=0
    if [ "$elapsed_ms" -gt 0 ]; then
        iters_per_sec=$((total_iters * 1000 / elapsed_ms))
    fi
    local perf_k=$((iters_per_sec / 1000))

    # 能效比 = 每毫瓦的千次迭代/秒
    local efficiency=0
    if [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ]; then
        efficiency=$((perf_k * 100 / power_mw))
    fi

    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_k,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  结果: 性能=${perf_k}k/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=${efficiency} | 温度 ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"
    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN
    return 0
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v3"
    log "=========================================="

    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
        log "错误: 无法读取电流"
        exit 1
    fi

    enable_screen_on
    log "初始温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "LOG: $LOG_FILE"
    log ""

    # 校准
    calibrate

    # CSV 头 (增加实际频率列)
    echo "核心组,目标MHz,实际MHz,耗时ms,基线uA,负载uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线°C,负载°C,性能k/s,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"

    # Governor
    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    log "Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log ""

    # ---- 中核 ----
    log "====== 中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    local mid_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核" && mid_ok=$((mid_ok + 1))
    done
    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
    log "中核完成: $mid_ok 个"
    log ""

    # ---- 大核 ----
    log "====== 大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    local big_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核" && big_ok=$((big_ok + 1))
    done
    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
    log "大核完成: $big_ok 个"
    log ""

    # 恢复
    echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    restore_screen

    log "=========================================="
    log "  完成! 温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "  CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
}

main "$@"

}

unlock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
    local min_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_min_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$min_avail" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$max_avail" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
}

get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

bind_cpus() {
    taskset -p "$1" $$ 2>/dev/null
}

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# 校准测试：确认工作负载是 CPU-bound
# 策略：跑两次不同迭代数，检查时间比例
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准工作负载..."

    # 锁定到中等频率
    lock_freq "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    bind_cpus "$MID_CPUS"
    sleep 1

    # 小批量
    local t1=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 100000 > /dev/null
    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_small=$((t2 - t1))

    # 大批量
    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 500000 > /dev/null
    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_large=$((t4 - t3))

    unlock_freq "$MID_POLICY"

    local ratio=$((ms_large * 100 / ms_small))
    log "  100k迭代: ${ms_small}ms | 500k迭代: ${ms_large}ms | 比例: ${ratio}%"

    # 理想比例应该是 ~500%
    if [ "$ratio" -gt 300 ] && [ "$ratio" -lt 700 ]; then
        log "  ✓ 工作负载可扩展性良好 (${ratio}%)"
    elif [ "$ratio" -gt 200 ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 工作负载可扩展性一般 (${ratio}%)"
    else
        log "  ✗ 工作负载可扩展性差 (${ratio}%)，结果可能不准确"
    fi
    log ""

    # 选择合适的迭代数：目标每轮 ~50ms
    local iter_per_ms=$((500000 / (ms_large + 1)))
    local target_iters=$((iter_per_ms * 50))
    # 下取整到万
    target_iters=$((target_iters / 10000 * 10000))
    [ "$target_iters" -lt 10000 ] && target_iters=10000
    [ "$target_iters" -gt 1000000 ] && target_iters=1000000

    log "  推荐每轮迭代数: $target_iters (目标 ~50ms/轮)"
    WORKLOAD_ITERS=$target_iters
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    lock_freq "$policy" "$freq"
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "  跳过: 无法锁定"
        return 1
    fi

    local actual_freq=$(cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  锁定: $((actual_freq/1000))MHz"

    bind_cpus "$cpus"
    sleep 0.5

    # 基线功耗
    log "  采样基线..."
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 运行负载
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s (每轮${WORKLOAD_ITERS}次)..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local end_ms=$((start_ms + BENCH_DURATION * 1000))
    local total_iters=0
    while [ $(get_time_ms) -lt $end_ms ]; do
        cpu_workload $WORKLOAD_ITERS > /dev/null
        total_iters=$((total_iters + WORKLOAD_ITERS))
    done
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))

    # 负载功耗
    log "  采样负载..."
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 功耗计算 (避免溢出)
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    # 性能 = 每秒千次迭代
    local iters_per_sec=0
    if [ "$elapsed_ms" -gt 0 ]; then
        iters_per_sec=$((total_iters * 1000 / elapsed_ms))
    fi
    local perf_k=$((iters_per_sec / 1000))

    # 能效比 = 每毫瓦的千次迭代/秒
    local efficiency=0
    if [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ]; then
        efficiency=$((perf_k * 100 / power_mw))
    fi

    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_k,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  结果: 性能=${perf_k}k/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=${efficiency} | 温度 ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"
    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN
    return 0
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v3"
    log "=========================================="

    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
        log "错误: 无法读取电流"
        exit 1
    fi

    enable_screen_on
    log "初始温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "LOG: $LOG_FILE"
    log ""

    # 校准
    calibrate

    # CSV 头 (增加实际频率列)
    echo "核心组,目标MHz,实际MHz,耗时ms,基线uA,负载uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线°C,负载°C,性能k/s,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"

    # Governor
    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    log "Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    log ""

    # ---- 中核 ----
    log "====== 中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    local mid_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核" && mid_ok=$((mid_ok + 1))
    done
    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
    log "中核完成: $mid_ok 个"
    log ""

    # ---- 大核 ----
    log "====== 大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    local big_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核" && big_ok=$((big_ok + 1))
    done
    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
    log "大核完成: $big_ok 个"
    log ""

    # 恢复
    echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
    echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
    restore_screen

    log "=========================================="
    log "  完成! 温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "  CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
}

main "$@"

这是因为 Android 16 的 **SELinux 安全策略**阻止了 sysfs 写入。即使有 root 权限，enforcing 模式下也会被拒绝。

input.content:
#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 权限诊断脚本
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/diagnose.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
OUTPUT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/diagnose_${TIMESTAMP}.txt"

log() {
    echo "$1"
    echo "$1" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
}

log "=============================="
log "  权限诊断"
log "  时间: $(date)"
log "=============================="
log ""

# 1. Root 检查
log "[1] Root 状态"
log "  UID: $(id -u)"
log "  用户: $(id)"
log ""

# 2. SELinux 状态
log "[2] SELinux 状态"
sestatus=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
log "  模式: $sestatus"
if [ "$sestatus" = "Enforcing" ]; then
    log "  ⚠ SELinux 是 Enforcing 模式，会阻止 sysfs 写入"
fi
log ""

# 3. sysfs 写入测试
log "[3] sysfs 写入测试"
test_file="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_min_freq"
log "  测试文件: $test_file"
log "  当前值: $(cat $test_file 2>/dev/null)"

# 尝试写入
echo "1152000" > "$test_file" 2>/tmp/sysfs_err
ret=$?
err=$(cat /tmp/sysfs_err 2>/dev/null)
log "  写入返回值: $ret"
if [ -n "$err" ]; then
    log "  错误信息: $err"
fi

# 检查写入后值是否变化
actual=$(cat "$test_file" 2>/dev/null)
log "  写入后值: $actual"
if [ "$actual" = "1152000" ]; then
    log "  ✓ 写入成功"
else
    log "  ✗ 写入失败"
fi
log ""

# 4. dmesg 权限拒绝日志
log "[4] 最近的 SELinux 拒绝日志"
dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -i "avc.*denied" | tail -5 | while read line; do
    log "  $line"
done
log ""

# 5. 尝试用 sysctl
log "[5] sysctl 测试"
sysctl -a 2>/dev/null | grep -i "sched\|cpufreq" | head -10 | while read line; do
    log "  $line"
done
log ""

# 6. 检查可用的频率控制接口
log "[6] 可用的频率控制接口"
for f in scaling_min_freq scaling_max_freq scaling_governor; do
    path="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/$f"
    perms=$(ls -la "$path" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  $perms"
done
log ""

# 7. 检查 walt governor 特有接口
log "[7] Walt Governor 接口"
for f in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/*; do
    name=$(basename "$f")
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then
        perms=$(ls -la "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1, $3, $4}')
        log "  $name: $perms"
    fi
done
log ""

# 8. 检查 vendor 扩展接口
log "[8] Vendor CPU 控制接口"
for f in /proc/sys/kernel/sched_*; do
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then
        name=$(basename "$f")
        perms=$(ls -la "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
        log "  $name: $perms"
    fi
done 2>/dev/null
log ""

log "=============================="
log "  诊断完成"
log "  结果: $OUTPUT_FILE"
log "=============================="

        echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
        sleep 0.5

        local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        local lower=$((freq * 95 / 100))
        local upper=$((freq * 105 / 100))
        if [ "$actual" -ge "$lower" ] && [ "$actual" -le "$upper" ] 2>/dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi
    fi

    # 策略2：只写 min（至少达到目标频率）
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 0.5

    local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    # 只用 min 时，频率可能高于目标，接受 >= 目标的 95%
    local lower=$((freq * 95 / 100))
    if [ "$actual" -ge "$lower" ] 2>/dev/null; then
        return 0
    fi

    return 1
}
